name: Enso
description: A circle drawn in one brush stroke, heavy at the start and dry at the tail, used as a progress ring or a loader.

props.name: value
props.description: Progress from 0 to 100. The brush is drawn to that point along the circle and moves on with a spring when the value changes. The element is then a progressbar. Leave it out for a loader.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the brush takes to draw the circle when there is no value.

props.name: loop
props.description: Without a value: draw, hold, fade and draw again. Set false to draw once and keep the circle.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. A loader defaults to "Loading" and is a status; pass an empty string when visible text beside it already says what is happening.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapping span. The ink is currentColor, foreground by default. Other span props are passed through.
